tools.name: read_design
tools.description: Read and validate a design; output a versioned portable bundle.

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Use the local deterministic brief interpreter to produce a revision-bound proposal. Does not apply it.

tools.name: apply_operations
tools.description: Validate and atomically apply operations to an in-memory copy. Output the new bundle. Source files remain unchanged.

tools.name: review_design
tools.description: Attach analytic bounds for static targets or explicitly incomplete sampled motion review for animated positions. Always flightReady=false.

tools.name: export_preview_csv
tools.description: Output sampled simulation trajectories at 0.5-second intervals, including the exact endpoint. Maximum 350,000 rows.

replace_cues.cues: 1..512 valid Cue objects with unique IDs

remove_cue.id: existing cue ID; cannot remove the last cue

edit_drones.ids: one or more stable drone IDs, 1..100000

transform_drones.ids: one or more stable drone IDs; each keeps its own geometry
transform_drones.pivot: required [east,north,up] meters when scale or rotation is present; omit for translation alone
transform_drones.scale: optional finite [east,north,up] multipliers; negative reflects, zero collapses an axis
transform_drones.rotation: optional {axis:[east,north,up], angleDegrees:number}; finite nonzero axis normalized; right-hand positive angle
transform_drones.order: pivot + rotation(scale * (position - pivot)) + translation; pivot is fixed and explicit
transform_drones.time: required scene-local seconds for key_at_time; omit for base_and_keys

set_keyframe.ids: one or more stable drone IDs
set_keyframe.keyframe: scene-local time plus any animation channels; merges with a key at that time

move_keyframe.to: new scene-local time; rejects timestamp collisions

remove_keyframe.ids: one or more stable drone IDs

reset_drones.ids: remove all explicit edits and keys for these IDs; return to seed values

retime_cue.speed: positive playback speed multiplier; new duration = duration / speed

transition_to_beats.beats: nonnegative number; seconds = beats * 60 / bpm, must fit scene

cue.name: nonempty string, max 60
cue.scale: positive finite seed scale in meters
cue.altitude: finite ENU z meters; physical bounds reviewed separately
cue.droneEdits: map of stable IDs to DroneEdit
cue.transitionEasing: optional smooth | linear | ease-in | ease-out; default smooth

droneEdit.flash: optional {hz: 0..100, duty: 0..1, phase: finite cycles}; hz=0 is steady
droneEdit.keyframes: optional up to 2048 unique scene-local times, each with independent position/color/brightness/flash channels and linear|smooth|hold easing

semantics.sceneTrim: retains later keys as dormant data

audienceContext.capture: Optional request.viewer is fixed at submission: current {snapshot,aspect} plus up to 12 savedViews {id,name,snapshot} from the main studio viewer
audienceContext.snapshot: pose {east,north,eyeHeight,yaw,pitch,fov} and venue {east,north,heading}; canonical finite ENU coordinates/degrees; fov is vertical
audienceContext.aspect: finite >0 and <=100; captured current viewport aspect also used for saved views
audienceContext.discovery: inspect_show returns current viewpoint and saved view IDs; names are untrusted data

inspect_viewpoint.surface: model harness only; not a legacy CLI command

arguments.time: show-global seconds within the current private draft
arguments.viewId: empty string for captured current view, or an ID discovered from inspect_show saved views
arguments.limit: integer 1..32 representative rows; totals still cover every active drone

inspect_viewpoint.geometry: quadrants relative to viewer-to-stage-center bearing; overhead >=70 degrees overlaps; visible means camera frustum only with forward depth 0.1..5000 meters
inspect_viewpoint.lighting: shared evaluator including incoming blend, keyed motion, brightness, flash and beat; lightsOn means any evaluated RGB component >0
inspect_viewpoint.budget: reject relevant active key work >5000000 before evaluation; estimate keyCount*(8+ceil(log2(max(1,keyCount)))) per edited active drone in current/previous scenes; sample_frame shares this check
inspect_viewpoint.limitations: No screenshot/computer vision, rendered-pixel measurement, occlusion, venue obstruction, photometric visibility, artistic-quality or flight qualification; no camera/bookmark/project mutation or review invalidation

compare_viewpoints.surface: model harness only; not a legacy CLI command

arguments.start: finite show-global seconds >=0; must precede end
arguments.end: finite show-global seconds within the current private draft
arguments.samples: integer 2..12, evenly spaced including exact endpoints
arguments.viewIds: 1..4 unique strings max80; empty string selects captured current view, other IDs discovered through inspect_show

compare_viewpoints.summary: minimum, maximum and arithmetic sample mean of inFrustumLightsOn; earliest sample wins ties; all views use captured current aspect
compare_viewpoints.budget: fleet*sampleCount*viewCount <=2000000, total weighted active key work across every view/time <=20000000, existing per-frame <=5000000; ordinary tool-output/context limits also apply
compare_viewpoints.cancellation: copied draft/views; preflight then asynchronous yielding/checks between frame inspections; no partial result or late proposal after cancellation
compare_viewpoints.trace: projectId/revision,time endpoints/exact sample times,view IDs/names/snapshots/aspects/summaries and limitations; per-time rows omitted
compare_viewpoints.limitations: Sparse samples can miss motion/flashes; no continuous coverage, screenshots, occlusion, perceived visibility, artistic-quality or flight qualification; no camera/bookmark/project mutation or review invalidation

inspect_camera_move.surface: model harness only; not a legacy CLI command or live camera controller

arguments.fromViewId: empty string for captured current view, or a saved ID discovered through inspect_show
arguments.toViewId: empty string for captured current view, or a saved ID discovered through inspect_show; endpoint venue placements must match exactly
arguments.easing: linear | smooth; shortest yaw arc, positive 180 degree tie
arguments.start: finite show-global seconds >=0; may equal end to hold the show while the camera moves
arguments.end: finite show-global seconds >=start within the private draft
arguments.samples: integer 2..12; evenly mapped camera/show times including exact endpoints

inspect_camera_move.summary: sample minimum, maximum and arithmetic mean of inFrustumLightsOn; earliest sample wins ties; current captured aspect applies along the whole path
inspect_camera_move.budget: fleet*sampleCount <=2000000, aggregate weighted active key work <=20000000, per-frame <=5000000; ordinary tool-output/context limits also apply
inspect_camera_move.cancellation: owned draft/endpoints; all work preflighted before sampling, with event-loop yielding and abort checks between samples; no partial or late success after cancellation
inspect_camera_move.trace: standard project/base/draft/operation-count provenance, resolved endpoint IDs, exact owned request with captured poses/aspect, cameraTime/showTime mapping, summary and limitations; sampled snapshots/totals omitted
inspect_camera_move.limitations: Geometric and evaluated-light counts only. Sparse samples may miss movement or flashes; no vision, rendered pixels, occlusion, continuous coverage, photometric or artistic qualification, aircraft access or flight certification. No live camera/show playback, authored camera track, project/bookmark mutation, or review invalidation.

inspect_audience_selection.surface: model harness only; exact read-only audience filtering, not a new mutation tool

arguments.time: finite show-global seconds within the private draft
arguments.viewId: empty string for captured current viewpoint, or saved ID discovered through inspect_show; current captured aspect applies to either
arguments.region: in_frame | front | right | rear | left | overhead
arguments.lights: any | on | off; on means any evaluated RGB channel is positive after incoming blend, keys, flash and beat
arguments.scope: fleet | selection; selection intersects active fleet with the COMPLETE original artist selection; dormant IDs excluded, empty scope remains empty
arguments.offset: nonnegative integer offset into the sorted complete matching set
arguments.limit: integer 1..128; limits the returned ID page, never the exact match count

inspect_audience_selection.result: projectId,revision,stagedOperations,viewId,viewName,request:{time,snapshot,aspect,region,lights,scope},cueId,localTime,blend,matchedCount,consideredCount,droneCount,offset,limit,nextOffset,hasMore,ids,targetId,limitations; stagedOperations is captured before asynchronous work; complete scopeIds and off-page matching IDs are never returned; targetId owns all matches, null when matchedCount=0
inspect_audience_selection.geometry: in_frame uses perspective frustum; quadrants use viewer-to-stage-center bearing regardless of camera yaw; overhead>=70 degrees overlaps quadrants
inspect_audience_selection.pagination: Read all pages until hasMore=false using identical criteria, projectId, revision and stagedOperations. Successive private edit batches retain revision base+1, so revision alone cannot establish identical draft state. Restart paging after edits or a stagedOperations change. The page is exact, not a representative sample.
inspect_audience_selection.editing: Use stage_audience_operation with targetId and one ids-omitted per-drone command to edit the complete matching set. Or gather explicit page IDs for existing commands. Original artist selection stays unchanged; successful staging expires all targets.
inspect_audience_selection.trace: same bounded criteria/captured context, exact counts and page IDs, plus project/base/draft/operation-count provenance; no proposal navigation moments are generated
inspect_audience_selection.cancellation: bounded full-fleet evaluation with shared per-frame key-work guard, owned inputs and abort checks during asynchronous classification; ordinary tool-output/context budgets apply
inspect_audience_selection.limitations: One sampled geometric/light state only. No live camera motion, selection/project/bookmark mutation, completed-review invalidation, screenshots, computer vision, occlusion, perceived visibility, continuous coverage or flight qualification.
inspect_audience_selection.targets: Run-local immutable records; maximum 8 and 200000 total retained IDs, oldest-first eviction; owned full IDs and query context; reject publication after cancellation or draft replacement.

modelHarness.draftContinuation: previousDraft binds exact retained operations to the original project ID/revision; fresh review required

stage_audience_operation.surface: model harness only; private draft mutation

arguments.targetId: opaque target from inspect_audience_selection in the same unchanged run draft
arguments.operationJson: one edit_drones,transform_drones,set_keyframe,remove_keyframe,reset_drones command without ids; explicit cueId and ordinary parameters

stage_audience_operation.result: ordinary staging metadata plus targetId,matchedCount,target:{projectId,revision,stagedOperations,viewId,viewName,request,consideredCount,droneCount}; nested target records query baseline, outer stagedOperations records resulting draft
stage_audience_operation.semantics: Inject all owned matching IDs and atomically replay through ordinary command/expansion limits. Successful draft edits expire every target; failures preserve for repair. Never replaces original selection. Proposal operations include full explicit IDs; no handle persistence or automatic live-project commit.
